notes.text: Section 137, act Mar. 3, 1875, ch. 132, § 3, 18 Stat. 449, related to requiring able-bodied male Indians to perform service on the reservation in order to receive appropriated supplies and annuities.
Section 138, R.S. § 2101, related to withholding of goods from chiefs violating treaty stipulations.

ancestors.heading: PERFORMANCE BY UNITED STATES OF OBLIGATIONS TO INDIANS
